_comment: Texts of the 'Reply language' system-prompt block, selected by BCP 47 tag; the opencode runtime ships the same texts. Non-ASCII characters stay JSON-escaped: source files in this repository are ASCII only.

mode_sentences.soft: This is the member's default; when the user's latest message is clearly written in another language, reply in that language instead.
mode_sentences.strict: Always reply in {display_name}, even when the user writes in another language, unless the user explicitly asks you to switch.

zh-Hans.language_sentence: Write your prose in Simplified Chinese as used in mainland China (简体中文).

zh-Hant-HK.language_sentence: Write your prose in Traditional Chinese characters using Standard Written Chinese with Hong Kong vocabulary (繁體中文，香港用語：軟件、伺服器、網絡、登入、設定、預設), not vernacular Cantonese and not Taiwan vocabulary.
